info.name: Safe Eduman API (v1)
info.description:
Postman collection for the Safe Eduman Laravel v1 API.

Scope: every route registered under `routes/api.php`.

**Base URL:** set `base_url` (default `http://localhost:8000`).

**Auth:** Uses Laravel Sanctum cookie-based session auth. Run **Auth → Login**; the session cookie is auto-saved and applied to protected requests. **IMPORTANT:** This collection uses cookie-based authentication, NOT bearer tokens. Ensure cookies are enabled in Postman settings.

Response envelope: `{ success, message, data, meta }` / `{ success:false, message, error_code, errors }`.

File-upload endpoints use multipart/form-data — pick a file in the form-data tab before sending.

item.name: Auth
item.description: routes/api.php - authentication endpoints for login, logout, and session management. Uses Sanctum SPA cookie sessions.

request.description: Logout current user and invalidate session
Get all active sessions for current user
Get dashboard statistics and overview data

item.name: Academic
item.description: routes/api.php - academic management. Uses generic setup controller for uniform resources (academic-years, classes, shifts, sections, groups, categories, subjects).

item.name: Students
item.description: routes/api.php - student management (enrollment, profiles, academic records). Requires students.manage permission.

item.name: Admissions
item.description: routes/api.php - admission applications and enrollment management. Requires admissions.manage permission.

request.description: Convert approved application to student record

item.name: HR
item.description: routes/api.php - human resources management. Requires hr.manage permission. Teacher data from this module is used by the CMS Teachers block for displaying teacher profiles on public pages.

query.description: Filter by employment status (active, resigned, terminated, retired)
Filter by employment type (permanent, contract, temporary)
Filter teachers by class configuration ID

request.description: List teaching staff. This endpoint is used by the CMS Teachers block to fetch teacher data for display on public pages. Supports filtering by status, designation, department, subject, and class configuration.

item.name: Routines
item.description: routes/api.php - class routines and schedules management. Requires routines.manage permission.

request.description: Get routines for specific class configuration

item.name: Attendance
item.description: routes/api.php - student and employee attendance management. Requires attendance.manage permission.

item.name: Examinations
item.description: routes/api.php - exam management, results processing, and academic performance. Requires examinations.manage permission.

item.name: CMS
item.description: routes/api.php - content management system. Public endpoints for frontend site, admin endpoints for content management. Includes block-based page builder with integration to HR module for Teachers block.

item.name: Public Site
item.description: routes/api.php - rendered public site for Next.js frontend. Unauthenticated, read-only, serving published CMS content.

request.description: Get site page by path (catch-all wildcard)
Get site navigation menu by key
Get terms for a taxonomy (e.g., categories, tags)
Get term by taxonomy and slug
